name: @ahv-remote-console/native-keyhook
description: Per-OS native keyboard grab (WH_KEYBOARD_LL / XGrabKeyboard) for VMware-style windowed keyboard auto-grab. Loaded only in the Electron main process.
author: The AHV Remote Console Authors

scripts._comment: No 'build' script ON PURPOSE: the repo's blanket `pnpm -r build` / `pnpm --filter ./packages/* build` would otherwise run prebuildify on toolchain-less runners. The prebuild is produced ONLY by the dedicated CI build:keyhook job via `build:native` (which also writes integrity.json).
